## Video-Catcher 0.5.0: the small things that make it round

Only the window changed; the browser extension is the same as in 0.4.0.

- **New:** a download tries again by itself when the connection drops: after 30 seconds, then after 2 minutes, and it goes on with what it has. Only then it says "The site could not be reached". Trouble with the video itself (login, DRM, deleted) is not tried again.
- **New:** while downloads run or wait, Windows does not go to sleep by itself. You can still send the PC to sleep, and "When all are done: sleep" works as before.
- **Changed:** a playlist of which single videos cannot be loaded (private, deleted, blocked) is no longer "failed" with everything else already in your folder. It is done, says how many are missing and why, and its files can be opened.
- **New:** a finished download shows its size, how long it took and when it ended. **Play** opens it, a playlist lists all its files (a click plays one), and a click on the site's name copies the link.
- **New:** **Next** puts a waiting download in front of the others, **Try failed again** takes all failed ones at once, and a search field filters the list by title, site, state or file name.
- **New:** a link that is already in the list is named before it is added a second time; a second click adds it anyway. A link sent twice from the browser while it still waits is taken once.
- **New:** Ctrl+V anywhere in the window takes the link in the clipboard and looks it up; several links are added straight away, like dropped ones. The **Paste** button now looks the link up too.
- **New:** the window title, and with it the taskbar, shows how far the downloads are ("42 % · 3 downloads").
- **New:** while the window is in the notification area, the icon tells you when a download failed and when all are done. A click on the balloon opens the window.
- **New:** when a newer Video-Catcher is out, the window says so at the bottom, with a link to the release page. For this it asks GitHub for the address of the newest release, at start (same setting as the look for yt-dlp) and with **Check for updates**. It sends nothing about you and installs nothing.
- **New:** **Copy details** below a failed download puts the message, the link, the version and what yt-dlp said into the clipboard, for a bug report.
- **New:** the window opens as large as it was when you closed it, also maximised.

Files: `VideoCatcher.exe` (or `VideoCatcher-arm64.exe`) and the extension (`VideoCatcher-extension-chromium.zip`, `VideoCatcher-extension-firefox.zip` or `.xpi`). The extension itself did not change.

The files are not digitally signed yet; Windows SmartScreen may warn. Every file is built by GitHub Actions from this repository, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists their checksums.
